subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing and actionable in these expense records.

judge.implied_focus: IT asset/equipment procurement spend captured in these expense records (what was bought, from whom, for whom, and for what use)

per_column.name: asset_type_category
per_column.rationale: Classifies the kind of asset purchased (laptop, server, cloud_service), a core facet of the procurement focus.

per_column.name: vendor_or_manufacturer
per_column.rationale: Identifies who supplied the asset, a key procurement dimension supporting vendor spend analysis.

per_column.name: department_assignment
per_column.rationale: Attributes the asset/expense to a consuming department, enabling cost allocation analysis around the focus.

per_column.name: processing_delay_indicator
per_column.rationale: A process-efficiency facet of the expense record; somewhat peripheral to the asset-procurement focus but still an actionable operational attribute of the same records.

per_column.name: asset_intended_use
per_column.rationale: Explains why the asset was purchased, deepening the procurement focus and enabling need-vs-spend analysis.

per_column.name: record_generation_method
per_column.rationale: Data-provenance metadata (auto vs manual entry); relates to record quality rather than the asset-procurement focus, diluting coherence.

judge.rationale: The columns clearly converge on a single inferable focus: IT asset procurement spend within expense records. asset_type_category, vendor_or_manufacturer, department_assignment, and asset_intended_use form a coherent, well-differentiated predictor/attribute set (what, who from, who for, why) at a useful granularity, allowing analyses like vendor concentration, department cost drivers, and need alignment. This is genuinely actionable. Two columns dilute the focus: processing_delay_indicator (operational efficiency facet) and especially record_generation_method (data provenance/quality metadata), which drift toward record-management rather than the procurement focus. The set is not a grab-bag and is not a mere restatement, but the two off-focus columns prevent top scores on coherence.
